title: Part Schematic
description: A mountable component attached to a unit's hardpoint. Categories: weapon, sensor, defense, mobility_aux, utility, communications. Each category uses a different subset of properties.

power_draw_kW.description: Continuous power draw while active. Set to 0 for purely passive parts.

slot_type.description: Which hardpoint slot types this part can be mounted in. 'universal' fits any slot. If absent, part is compatible with any hardpoint.

propellant_energy_MJ.description: Energy released per shot. For beam weapons, energy per discharge.

barrel_thermal_capacity_MJ.description: Maximum heat the weapon can hold before forced cooldown.

cooling_rate_MJs.description: Passive cooling rate in MJ per second.

drag_coefficient.description: Drag coefficient for projectile. Used in ballistics equation.

elevation_range_deg.description: [min, max] elevation in degrees. -10 to 60 typical for tanks; 0 to 85 for AA; -5 to 5 for direct-fire.

charge_time_ms.description: Firing pattern: delay (ms) between trigger and the first shot leaving the barrel. Default 0 (fire immediately).

fire_rate_ms.description: Firing pattern: time (ms) between shots in sustained fire. Acts as the default for burst_delay_ms when that is unset. Default 0.

burst_count.description: Firing pattern: shots per Fire trigger (1 = single shot, 3 = triple-burst). Default 1.

burst_delay_ms.description: Firing pattern: time (ms) between shots WITHIN a single burst. Default 0 (back-to-back).

cooldown_ms.description: Firing pattern: lockout (ms) after the burst completes, before the weapon can fire again. Default 0.

sensor_active.description: Active sensors emit (detectable by counter-sensors); passive sensors do not.

mobility_bonus_speed.description: Multiplicative bonus to chassis speed. 1.0 = no change; 1.2 = 20% faster.
